label: Shape waves
desc: Rows of triangles, circles, squares or diamonds riding travelling sine waves, turning with the slope and swelling near the pointer.
use: Behind a landing hero, feature band or empty state (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Side rays
desc: Soft shafts of light entering from the left and right edges in the brand colours, breathing and swaying; the left source follows the pointer height.
use: Behind a hero or pricing section where light from the side frames the content (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Silk
desc: Soft flowing satin: overlapping translucent ribbons with a sheen band that read as folds of cloth; the pointer gathers them.
use: Behind a landing hero, sign-in panel or footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Sliced waves
desc: Three wave bands cut into vertical slabs with thin gaps; slabs near the pointer lift.
use: Behind a hero, stats band or footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Threads
desc: Flowing hairline threads that pinch together at two waists and fan out again; they bend away from the pointer.
use: Behind a hero or section divider (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Topography
desc: An animated contour map: a drifting height field traced into iso-lines with marching squares; the pointer raises a hill.
use: Behind a hero, docs landing or 404 page (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Web threads
desc: A spider-web of spoke and ring threads on spring joints that the pointer plucks; they ring and settle, with an idle ghost pluck.
use: Behind a hero, error page or contact section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
